age_limit.details: Maximum age limit is 35 years for all posts. Age relaxation will be provided as per applicable rules.

qualification.details: Project Technical Support-III: Three-year graduate degree in Nursing or Allied Health Sciences from a recognized university with three years of post-qualification experience in clinical research, multicentre research projects, neonatal/paediatric care, public health research or a related field; OR Postgraduate degree in any of the above disciplines from a recognized university. Project Nurse-III (Recruitment): Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery from a recognized institution and registration with the State/Indian Nursing Council. B.Sc. Nursing. Experience in labour room, maternity ward, neonatal care or clinical research projects. Project Nurse-III (Follow-up): Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery from a recognized institution and registration with the State/Indian Nursing Council. B.Sc. Nursing. Experience in neonatal/paediatric follow-up, growth or developmental assessment, or clinical research projects. Project Nurse-III (Clinical Psychologist): Master's degree in Clinical Psychology from a recognized university in India. Preferably a Child Psychologist with experience of working with infants/children. Experience or training in BSID-IV and DASII developmental assessment tools.

salary_details.details: Consolidated emoluments of Rs. 33,600 per month for all posts (Rs. 28,000 + 20% HRA).

selection_process: Shortlisting on the basis of qualifications and experience Written screening examination and/or interaction
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for GMCH Chandigarh Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: gmch.gov.in/.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 14-09-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GMCH Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the GMCH Chandigarh Research Staff positions is 14th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Research Staff at GMCH Chandigarh?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies for various Research Staff positions at Government Medical College Hospital Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: For Project Technical Support-III, candidates need a three-year graduate degree in Nursing or Allied Health Sciences with three years of experience, or a postgraduate degree in the same fields.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Research Staff posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Research Staff posts is 35 years, with age relaxation applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: All selected candidates will receive a consolidated emolument of Rs. 33,600 per month, which includes Rs. 28,000 plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for GMCH Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their filled application forms via post.

faq.question: Q7. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Required documents include a filled application form, CV, reference letters, photograph, proof of age and qualifications, experience certificates, and an NOC if employed.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: The application form should be sent to the Department of Neonatology, Level-4, Block D, Government Medical College Hospital, Sector 32, Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the GMCH Chandigarh Research Staff positions.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for the Research Staff positions?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on shortlisting of applications, followed by a written screening examination and/or an interaction with the candidates.
